4. Any residual reference anywhere in these three files (or elsewhere you notice) to the retired 'exactly four operations' framing that this run's own design rework flagged as retired by decision 0017 -- if you spot one incidentally, note it (MINOR) but do not fix it yourself unless it's in one of this run's own three owned files.
